steps: TAG=fast SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5' STRATEGIES='decent sloppy always_expand never_expand' EXTRA='--clock=fast' LIMIT=300 qa/bots/run_batch.sh <dir>. Timer: TAG=timer SEEDS='1 2 3' EXTRA='--clock=timer' LIMIT=600, same strategies.
expected: always_expand is not better than decent and not a second winning route without a design reason; the known finding is re-checked, not re-derived.
actual: Re-confirmed. always_expand wins 5/5 on the fast clock (cycles 25-26, END_ENOUGH on seeds 1,3,5 and END_CORP_MIX on seeds 2,4) and 3/3 on the timer clock, with final cash identical to decent on every seed.

steps: Run the same seed and strategy on both clocks: EXTRA='--clock=fast' and EXTRA='--clock=timer' via qa/bots/run_batch.sh with SEEDS='1 2 3' STRATEGIES='decent never_expand'. Reruns of fast decent seeds 1 and 3 reproduce exactly (9498 and 8538), so the difference is not noise.
expected: Either the fast and timer clocks give the same cycle-end cash for the same seed, or the design states that real-time play changes the economy.
actual: Final cash differs on every seed that buys ships. decent: seed 1 9498 fast vs 8802 timer (both win at 26); seed 2 8826 vs 8670 (both 26); seed 3 8538 (win 25) vs 8552 (win 27). never_expand: seed 1 4554 vs 3851; seed 2 4454 vs 4223; seed 3 4891 vs 4707. sloppy is identical on both clocks (3088, 3639, 4103). Seed 3 decent first differs at cycle 13 (cash 2825 vs 2725). Win cycle moves by 2 cycles on seed 3, still inside 22-30.

steps: Release export check: tools/godot/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot --headless --path <repo> --export-release "macOS" <scratch>/StarBazaar.zip (real HOME, so the installed templates are found).
expected: Release export builds from export_presets.cfg and the release build shows no debug or game-control menu.
actual: Export fails: 'Requested template binary godot_macos_release.universal not found. It might be missing from your template archive.' The installed macos.zip template has no release binary, so the release build was not run. Static check only: game/main.gd creates debug_menu only under debug_tools_allowed() (OS.is_debug_build()), and export_filter excludes qa/*, tools/* and handoffs/*. Not verified at runtime.

steps: Natural run: TAG=fast SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5' STRATEGIES=decent EXTRA='--clock=fast' via qa/bots/run_batch.sh. Read decisions_by_kind for permit_buy.
expected: Per the T17 brief, decent buys permits, so permit-gated content is reachable on a natural run.
actual: No permit is bought in any decent run (no permit_buy key in decisions_by_kind, permits_bought null). bot_run.gd header says 'Permits: none in this build', so the brief and the bot disagree. Permit-gated endings (FULL needs permit 2 and C1 per T80) are not reached naturally; they only appear with --permit=2.
